chapter.heading: Praise to God for His Everlasting Mercy
chapter.v:
Oh, give
thanks to the Lord, for He is good!For His mercy endures forever. [Jer. 3:1, 22; 15:19; Joel 2:12]

Let Israel
now say,“His mercy endures forever.” [Deut. 10:20; Is. 45:23; 65:16; Jer. 12:16 c Is. 48:1; Zech. 8:8 d [Gen. 22:18]; Ps. 72:18; Is. 65:16; Jer. 3:17; [Gal. 3:8] e Is. 45:25; Jer. 9:24; 1 Cor. 1:31; 2 Cor.]

Let the
house of Aaron now say,“His mercy endures forever.” [Matt. 13:7] [Hos. 10:12]

Let those
who fear the Lord now say,“His mercy endures forever.” [Deut. 10:16; 30:6; Jer. 9:25, 26; [Rom. 2:28, 29; Col. 2:11]]

I called
on the Lord in distress;The Lord answered me and set me in a broad place.

The Lord
is on my side;I will not fear.What can man do to me? [Jer. 1:13-15; 6:1,]

The Lord
is for me among those who help me;Therefore I shall see my desire on those who hate me. [2 Kin. 24:1; Dan. 7:4 m Jer. 25:9; Ezek. 26:7-]

It is
better to trust in the LordThan to put confidence in man. [Is. 22:12; Jer.]

It is
better to trust in the LordThan to put confidence in princes.

All nations
surrounded me,But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them. [Is. 1:7; 6:11; Jer. 2:15] [2 Kin. 25:10- 12; Ezek. 14:9; 2 Thess. 2:11 q Jer.]

They surrounded
me,Yes, they surrounded me;But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them. [Jer. 51:1; Ezek. 17:10; Hos. 13:15]

They surrounded
me like bees;They were quenched like a fire of thorns;For in the name of the Lord I will destroy them. [Jer. 1:16]

You pushed
me violently, that I might fall,But the Lord helped me. [Is. 5:28 u Deut. 28:49; Lam. 4:19; Hos. 8:1; Hab. 1:8]

The Lord
is my strength and song,And He has become my salvation. [Prov. 1:22; Is. 1:16; Jer. 13:27; James 4:8]

The voice
of rejoicing and salvationIs in the tents of the righteous;The right hand of the Lord does valiantly. [Jer. 8:16;]

The right
hand of the Lord is exalted;The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.

I shall
not die, but live,And declare the works of the Lord. [2 Kin. 25:1,]

The Lord
has chastened me severely,But He has not given me over to death. [Ps. 107:17; Is. 50:1; Jer. 2:17,]

Open to
me the gates of righteousness;I will go through them,And I will praise the Lord. [2 Kin. 25:11; 2 Chr. 36:20; Is. 22:4; Jer. 9:1, 10;]

This is
the gate of the Lord,Through which the righteous shall enter. [Ps. 42:7; Ezek. 7:26 c Jer. 10:20]

I will
praise You,For You have answered me,And have become my salvation.

The stone
which the builders rejectedHas become the chief cornerstone. [Jer. 9:3; 13:23; Rom. 16:19; 1 Cor.]

This was
the Lord’s doing;It is marvelous in our eyes. [Gen. 1:2] [Is. 24:19]

This is
the day the Lord has made;We will rejoice and be glad in it. [Is. 5:25; Jer. 10:10; Ezek. 38:20]

Save now,
I pray, O Lord;O Lord, I pray, send now prosperity. [Jer. 9:10; 12:4; Zeph. 1:3]

Blessed is
he who comes in the name of the Lord!We have blessed you from the house of the Lord. [Jer. 9:10]

God is
the Lord,And He has given us light;Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar. [Jer. 5:10, 18;]

You are
my God, and I will praise You;You are my God, I will exalt You.

Oh, give
thanks to the Lord, for He is good!For His mercy endures forever.
